labeling_note: CLI pair-programming agent that supports many LLM providers; model-owned artifacts are not applicable.

criteria.rationale: Project dependencies are declared in pyproject.toml.
A Dockerfile provides a containerized environment.
Aider is a coding agent application, not a project-owned dataset pipeline.
Aider supports many cloud and local LLMs and does not own a model card.
The repository has a code license, but no project-owned model license.
A benchmark/test suite provides executable verification.
Aider is not a training experiment and does not require a training seed.
Tests, CI and benchmark scripts are present.
Prompt construction exists in code, but no prompt version or hash metadata is recorded.
Model parameters are configurable, but no fixed sampling configuration is documented.
Aider is not a RAG application with a project-owned knowledge index.
Tracing hooks exist, but no durable tool-call trace artifact is required or documented.
A benchmark is mentioned, but data splits and contamination analysis are not documented.
Cost tracking is implemented, but no reproducible cost or latency measurement is provided.
